topics.search_demand_note: Parent demand anchored on parking-mode autocomplete and a Reddit thread asking for continuous parked recording; volume unknown, demand direction confirmed by two source types.
topics.business_question: When a buyer wants the car watched while parked, does AI describe parking mode as continuous, and does it say what installation and power it needs?
topics.possible_action: Fix the headline/FAQ contradiction on the H1 page (24/7 protection vs dedicated hardwire kit required), publish a parking-mode installation and power-draw page, and seed third-party reviews with parking footage.

topics.parent_demand: 4 channel dash cam / dash cam night vision (autocomplete seed '4 channel dash cam with parking mode'; Reddit night plate-capture threads)
topics.search_demand_note: Parent demand anchored on 4-channel autocomplete plus two Reddit threads that name night plate capture and Sony STARVIS explicitly; volume unknown.
topics.business_question: When evidence quality is the job, does AI recommend multi-angle coverage and name the night/low-light proof needed to read a plate?
topics.possible_action: Publish the sensor/HDR spec and real night plate footage, and comparison content that puts 3K front + three 1080p cameras next to dual-camera options; this is where the H1's four-camera lead can be made citable.

attribute_plan.evidence: Q04 (true 4K + STARVIS 2 to read plates at night), Q05 (buyers repeat the STARVIS advice), Q06 (night footage checked before price). Official H1 page publishes only 'Night Vision · Enhanced Low-Light Capture' with no sensor model, no HDR and no sample night footage (fact check 夜视传感器型号 → 提供材料); 4-camera H1 front is 3K. Competitor pages publish STARVIS 2 / HDR.

Q01 (continuous parked recording, not only when bumped), Q02 (what else must be bought), Q09 (4-channel + parking mode), Q10 (parking without hardwire), Q11 (battery drain). Own page headline '24/7 Parking Protection' contradicts its FAQ 'A dedicated hardwire kit is required', time-lapse capped at 24 h (fact check 停车监控是否需要另购配件 → 改官网). RivalB3 N5 states hardwire required and sold separately, so the capability is category parity; the contradiction is the gap.

attribute_plan.gap_type: none (spec published; lead not yet third-party citable)
attribute_plan.evidence: Q03 (maximum exterior coverage), Q09 (4-channel). H1: front 3K + rear/left/right 1080p on four cameras, published on the product page; RivalB3 N5 front 2.7K, RivalB4 VisionPano 40 front 2.5K (scope fact 2). Spec is readable on the official page, so changeability is 中 rather than an evidence gap.

attribute_plan.gap_type: needs competitor terms (RivalB2 / RivalB3 / RivalB1 warranty pages were not collected)
attribute_plan.evidence: Q12 (warranty searched before buying), Q08 (service quality decides trust). Bbrand page states 1-Year Warranty, money-back guarantee and 24/7 customer service; RivalB4 VP40 publishes 2 years. The frozen competitors' terms are not in the research, so no verdict is inferred.
Q07 (hot summers, internal battery swelling), Q06 (heat tolerance on the pre-price checklist). H1 publishes supercapacitor -20 °C to 70 °C; competitor operating ranges were not collected.

attribute_plan.gap_type: no answer-layer sentiment matrix (presales pass was visibility only); provisional
attribute_plan.evidence: Q08: a buyer reports Reddit posts about faulty units and poor service despite good review-site scores, with a $200 cap. No theme-level competitor negatives were collected, so no opening is claimed.

attribute_plan.gap_type: none (promotion-driven; price is a live variable)
attribute_plan.evidence: Q04 ($100 cap), Q08 ($200 cap), Q06 (price checked last). H1 sale price $209 against $299 list; RivalB3 N5 lists $379.99. Price moves with promotions, so the Prompt sits in the experimental layer.
Q06 (SD card support on the checklist), Q01/Q09 (long parked recording). H1 includes 128 GB and supports up to 512 GB; RivalB3 N5 supports up to 1 TB. Capacity is a hardware limit, not a content gap.
Q06 raises screen brightness at night once, as one item in a pre-price checklist; no buyer treats it as a shortlist criterion.
attribute_plan.no_carrier_reason: P3: buyers raise night screen brightness as a minor checklist item (Q06), not a shortlist or rejection criterion, so no independent Discovery decision exists; kept visible so the client can disagree.

collection_config.cadence: candidate baseline 5 runs per Prompt per platform, then weekly after lock
